exploration_robot.evidence: Actual normalized GLB inspected in local WebGL viewer: +X view shows central camera eye; -X view shows rear head casing. Rotate +90 degrees around Y to map +X to gameplay -Z.
exploration_robot.notes: Four compact articulated legs, metallic joints, off-white ceramic casing and ice-blue eye; no scenery or separate display base.

spacecraft.evidence: Actual GLB +X view shows nose aperture, lights and cockpit; -X view shows two rear thrusters.
spacecraft.notes: Compact shuttle with short side wings; rotate +90 degrees around Y so nose points along gameplay -Z.

energy_core.evidence: Actual GLB inspected front, side and reverse: enclosed ice-blue chamber and connected metallic cage; both axial sides readable.
energy_core.notes: No unique semantic front. Align chamber axis with gameplay forward for presentation; not a directional requirement.

micro_probe.evidence: Actual normalized GLB inspected in front three-quarter and +X cardinal views; optical/hatch face points +X.
micro_probe.notes: Compact spherical scientific instrument with attached optical pods, short antennas and forward lens. Distinct from four-legged robot.

heavy_capsule.evidence: Actual normalized GLB inspected in front three-quarter and +X cardinal views; optical/hatch face points +X.
heavy_capsule.notes: Reinforced transport pod with integrated feet, thick armor ribs, hatch-like front chamber and amber locks; no separate scenery.

beacon.evidence: Actual GLB +X view shows ice-blue signal panel and front access cover; upright structure and attached feet verified in three-quarter view.
beacon.notes: Compact standing transmitter with white armor, metallic feet, blue panel and amber indicators.
